title: Norman's Neighborhood: North Little Rock brothers take passion for photography as triumph over tragedy - NewsBreak
text: NORTH LITTLE ROCK, Ark. – Bringing visions to life is the motto for 19-year-old photographer Jamarion. Jamarion got into photography after watching his older brother Malachi. “When I saw him doing it, I wanted to do it because I thought it was cool,” Jamarion said. Something cool turned into a collaborative passion. Yet, passion for photography stemmed from pain. Jamarion and Malachi were left to maneuver through life without their parents. Their mom passed away from a blood clot, and their dad was killed in a car accident. “I did lose myself at one point, but we have to use that pain and use it to fuel our fire so we can keep going,” Malachi said. “Don’t let anyone come by and tell you that your dreams aren’t worth reaching,” Officer Tommy Norman said. Officer Norman shared their story on social media, and it touched thousands of people. One lady even sent Jamarion a camera. Leaning on and believing in one another is how they’ve been able to press on. Malachi gifted Jamarion with his dream camera. “I invested in him because he said he had a dream, and I want him to go with the plan,” he said. Malachi says the investment was worth it because if you’ve ever been down like these two siblings, every chance you get to smile is considered a win in life.
